summary: The registrant filed an 8-K reporting Q1 2026 financial results (Item 2.02) and disclosed entry into token purchase agreements (Item 8.01) for a private placement of 740 million ARC tokens at $0.30 per token, implying a $3 billion fully diluted valuation and gross proceeds of ~$222 million. The sale, led by a16z crypto, relies on Rule 506(b) of Regulation D. Lock-up restrictions apply for at least one year after mainnet transition, with extended lock-up for four years; repayment rights arise if tokens are not delivered or transition is not completed by May 2028. The filing is an issuer token presale, not a traditional securities special situation. What to watch: regulatory treatment of token presales and timeline for Arc network transition, as repayment triggers create contingent liability.
